div.div:
PROPOSED: adapt domain, hosts and bucket; provision EC2 / EBS / DNS / firewall separately. Expose 80/443; restrict SSH.
Keep PostgreSQL / Redis internal. Single host is a failure domain; snapshots supplement database-consistent backups.
